compile.note: cold build runs the default 'lsaca build -r' once per compile_repeats repeat, each time with a fresh LSACA_CACHE_DIR (multi-file mode: 'lsaca build -r <crate root>' where the root file's 'mod' declarations load the sibling module files); the cached build re-uses the same cache directory and only re-links the executable

package_compile.description: package with path dependencies: the binary package compile_app plus the library packages util_a and util_b (util_b depends on util_a), about 1,090 lines spread over thirteen files, used to measure package-mode builds

compile.backend: direct C compiler back end (default; --cmake available)
compile.note: cold build runs the default 'lsaca build -r' once per compile_repeats repeat, each time with a fresh LSACA_CACHE_DIR (package mode: 'lsaca build -r' with no file argument from the package directory (the manifest is discovered upward and path dependencies are built)); the cached build re-uses the same cache directory and only re-links the executable

validation: all measured runs matched the expected checksum
